note: Chargebacks filed against transactions in this period. Each is a one-click Investigate demo entry.

disputes.cardholderStatement: I never received this rug. I have been charged $349 for something that never arrived at my home.
disputes.label: Not received — delivered and signed for
disputes.blurb: Cardholder claims non-delivery on an order that was signed for at the billing address.

disputes.cardholderStatement: The lamp was never delivered. Support told me twice they would send a replacement and never did.
disputes.label: Not received — delivery ZIP mismatch
disputes.blurb: Carrier says delivered, but to the wrong postcode, unsigned, and a promised reship never happened.

disputes.cardholderStatement: I did not authorise this. I have never signed up for any subscription with this merchant.
disputes.label: Unauthorised — subscription renewal
disputes.blurb: Seventh renewal on a consented signup, but notice emails bounced and the account has been dormant.

disputes.cardholderStatement: I was charged $75 twice for one kettle. Support told me one charge would drop off and it did not.
disputes.label: Duplicate processing — two captures
disputes.blurb: Our own ledger shows two settled captures against one order. The cardholder is right.
